argv: pid=$(pgrep -x claude | head -1); echo "claude pid found: $([ -n "$pid" ] && echo yes)"; echo "placeholder key lines: $(tr "\0" "\n" < /proc/$pid/environ | grep -c "^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=provided-by-worker$")"; echo "any other ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value: $(tr "\0" "\n" < /proc/$pid/environ | grep "^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=" | grep -vc "=provided-by-worker$")"; node -e "fetch(\"https://example.com/\").then(r=>console.log(\"example.com status\", r.status)).catch(e=>console.log(\"example.com error\", e.cause?.code ?? e.message))"; node -e "fetch(\"https://registry.npmjs.org/\").then(r=>console.log(\"npm registry status\", r.status)).catch(e=>console.log(\"npm error\", e.message))"

json.stdout:
claude pid found: yes
placeholder key lines: 1
any other ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value: 0
example.com status 403
npm registry status 403
